questionsList.content: ENW493c PE Writing Prompt: Many people believe that good planning is the key factor to success in life, while hard work and supportive relationships are important. Discuss both views and give your opinion (450-500 words).
questionsList.explanation: 📌 HƯỚNG DẪN BÀI VIẾT THI THỰC HÀNH (PE WRITING MASTER GUIDE & BAND 8.0 SAMPLE): 1. CẤU TRÚC BÀI LUẬN 4 ĐOẠN (ESSAY OUTLINE): - Introduction: Hook + Rephrase Prompt + Thesis Statement (Stating that while hard work and relationships build foundation, strategic planning optimizes resources for long-term success). - Body 1 (Hard Work & Supportive Relationships): Analyze how diligence creates momentum and social networks provide emotional/financial backing. - Body 2 (Good Planning as Key Factor): Explain how planning provides clear vision, risk mitigation, resource allocation, and milestone tracking. - Conclusion: Restate opinion & final synthesis. 2. TỪ VỰNG HỌC THUẬT NÂNG CAO (ACADEMIC VOCABULARY): - Strategic foresight (tầm nhìn chiến lược), Resource allocation (phân bổ nguồn lực), Risk mitigation (giảm thiểu rủi ro), Interpersonal synergy (sự cộng hưởng mối quan hệ).

answers.content: Option A: Discuss both views and provide a balanced argument with planning as primary driver
Option B: Only write about hard work without mentioning planning
Option C: Write less than 200 words without structure
Option D: Copy the prompt word for word without thesis statement
